svg.title: The pipeline from the poster: the dry stems and the same stems processed, drawn as spectrograms, go into FX-JEPA, which predicts a settings grid: for each of 4 stems, 11 effects on or off and 28 knobs. The dry stems are rendered once and the render is compared with the reference using MRSTFT, a spectral distance where lower is better. The grid and the example settings under it are illustrations, not a real prediction. Beside the pipeline, three numbers: -10.9% for the slot readout added to our baseline with the same encoder, -16% for the best model against our baseline (second run -10%), and a tie between the JEPA objective and knob loss alone on a held-out test scored once, with earlier models.
